<div style="margin-top: -25px; text-align: center;">

```{.d2 pad="10" width="90%" height="500px"}
direction: down

# In D2 + quarto-d2, Dagre's inter-rank arrow gap (~60 SVG units) is fixed in
# internal SVG coordinates. Scaling UP the box dimensions (width/height) and
# font-size inside D2—while Quarto scales the outer SVG to height="500px"—makes
# the boxes larger and the arrows proportionally much shorter.

classes: {
  # 1. Upstream Inputs (Sky Blue)
  input_db: {
    shape: cylinder
    width: 230
    height: 80
    style: { fill: "#BAE6FD"; stroke: "#0284C7"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 22; bold: true }
  }
  input_data: {
    shape: parallelogram
    width: 240
    height: 68
    style: { fill: "#BAE6FD"; stroke: "#0284C7"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 22 }
  }

  # 2. Model Setup (Teal)
  model_spec: {
    shape: rectangle
    width: 320
    height: 66
    style: { fill: "#99F6E4"; stroke: "#0F766E"; stroke-width: 3; border-radius: 10; font-size: 22; bold: true }
  }

  # 3. Software & Computational Environment (Warm Berry/Magenta — or use fill: "#CBD5E1"; stroke: "#334155" for Slate Gray)
  code_env: {
    shape: rectangle
    width: 230
    height: 68
    style: { fill: "#FBCFE8"; stroke: "#BE185D"; stroke-width: 3; border-radius: 10; font-size: 22 }
  }

  # 4. Active Execution & Processing Steps (Rich Amber)
  process_step: {
    shape: hexagon
    width: 340
    height: 74
    style: { fill: "#FDE68A"; stroke: "#B45309"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 22; bold: true }
  }

  # 5. Generated Data & Repository Curation (Emerald Green)
  output_files: {
    shape: page
    width: 280
    height: 72
    style: { fill: "#BBF7D0"; stroke: "#15803D"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 22; bold: true }
  }
  curation_repo: {
    shape: cylinder
    width: 300
    height: 80
    style: { fill: "#86EFAC"; stroke: "#166534"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 22; bold: true }
  }

  # 6. Bottleneck Callout (Coral Red)
  bottleneck: {
    shape: callout
    width: 210
    height: 76
    style: { fill: "#FECACA"; stroke: "#B91C1C"; stroke-width: 3; font-size: 20; bold: true }
  }
}

# Row 1: Upstream Scientific Inputs
calphad: "CALPHAD\nDatabases" { class: input_db }
exp: "Experimental\nMeasurements" { class: input_data }
atomistic: "Atomistic\nSimulations" { class: input_data }

# Left Column: Code & Environment (M3) + Volume Callout
sim_code: "Solver" { class: code_env }
comp_env: "Computational\nEnvironment" { class: code_env }

# Main Vertical Spine: Model -> Execution -> Data -> Curation
prob_spec: "Problem Specification" { class: model_spec }
comp_model: "Numerical Model" { class: model_spec }
pf_sim: "Phase-Field Simulation" { class: process_step }
raw_data: "Raw Field Data" { class: output_files }
post_proc: "Post-processing" { class: process_step }
curation: "Curation & Repository" { class: curation_repo }

# Visible Workflow Connections
calphad -> prob_spec: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
exp -> prob_spec: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
atomistic -> prob_spec: { style.stroke-width: 3 }

prob_spec -> comp_model: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
comp_model -> sim_code: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
sim_code -> pf_sim: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
comp_env -> sim_code: { style.stroke-width: 3 }

pf_sim -> raw_data: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
raw_data -> post_proc: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
post_proc -> curation: { style.stroke-width: 3 }
raw_data -> curation: { style.stroke-width: 3 }

# Invisible rank-alignment edges to keep left column tight
calphad -> sim_code: { style.opacity: 0 }
sim_code -> comp_env: { style.opacity: 0 }
```

</div>
